description: Gebiete Rettungswachen Südwestsachsen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Area of application of the respective rescue guards for the area of the rescue purpose association Southwest Saxony. The remit of the Rescue Purpose Association relates to the Vogtlandkreis and the district of Zwickauer Land. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Areas Lifeguards Southwestern Saxony" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Rettungsdienst, Feuerwehr, Gesundheit und Sicherheit, Südwestsachsen, Leitstelle, Gesundheitseinrichtung. The listing shows 2025-05-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
